item.title: South Korea, US Drills Show Clear Hostility Toward North Korea - Kim Jong Un’s Sister
item.summary: SEOUL (Sputnik) - Kim Yo Jong, the director of the General Department of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, said on Wednesday that North Korea is completely uninterested in the US-South Korea decision to halve their joint military exercises.
